parameters.name: EnabledIpv6
parameters.description: Specifies whether IPv6 is enabled. A value of true indicates that IPv6 is enabled. A value of false indicates that IPv6 is not enabled. If you leave this parameter empty, the system does not filter by this property.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paging. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the VPC-connected instance.

You can invoke the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID.

- If you specify a zone ID, the system queries only the vSwitches that are in the specified zone of the VPC-connected instance.
- If you do not specify a zone ID, the system queries the vSwitches in all active zones of the VPC-connected instance by default.

You can invoke the [DescribeZones](~~36064~~) operation to query zone IDs.
